paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在右侧栏文件预览的行号前注入 Git Blame 列，悬停显示提交信息（DSH plugin）
# Git Blame on Hover
English | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness plugin. When a text or source file is opened in the right
sidebar's file preview,

hovering a line shows a small card with that line's
`git blame` information (author, short commit h
ash, date, and commit summary).
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness; this plugin targets DSH `^0.2.1-rc.5`.

- **From npm**: open the Plugins page → **添加插件 / Add plugin** and enter the
package name `dsh-plugin

-git-blame`, or run `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-git-blame`.
- **From this repository (git)**: in the

same dialog paste the repository URL, or
run `dsh plugin add github:badpx/dsh-plugin-git-blame`.
### Discoverability (plugin market)

DSH does not crawl GitHub or npm on its own. Third-party plugins are surfaced by
the experimental **

plugin market**: a *Discover* tab that reads **plugin market
index** JSON documents whose URLs you a

dd in Settings. The index follows format 1
of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`; its `plugins[]

.versions[].source` is
either `{ "type": "npm" }` or a git entry pinned to a full 40-hex commit:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Host the index over https and add that URL in the Discover/Settings UI. This
repository ships a read

y-made `market-index.json`; add its
raw URL
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/badpx/dsh-plugin-git-

blame/main/market-index.json`
as an index source. After publishing to npm you can switch a version t

o
`"source": { "type": "npm" }` (the installer builds the exact `name@version`).
Git sources are com
mit-pinned, so refresh the `commit` on each release.
## How it works

- **Host** (`index.js`): registers `GET /plugin/git-blame?sessionId=&path=&line=`.
It resolves the f

ile against the Session's working directory, runs
`git blame --line-porcelain -L <line>,<line> -- <f

ile>`, and returns JSON.
Only files inside the Session working directory are eligible.
- **Client**

(`client.js`): registers one occupant of `shell.overlay`. A
pointer-move listener detects when the p

ointer is over a line in
`[data-code-preview]` or `[data-textpreview-plain]` inside the right sideba

r,
maps the hovered tab to its `dsh-resource://file/...` address, and asks the
Host route for the bl

ed tab to its `dsh-resource://file/...` address, and asks the
Host route for the blame of that line.

A toggle button in the preview header turns the inline blame column on or off and
remembers the choi

ce. Both the toggle and the column only appear for files that
are **text and tracked by Git**; untra
cked or binary files show neither.
## Inline blame column

For the built-in highlighted code preview the plugin injects a fixed-width
gutter column just left o

f the line numbers. Each row shows `date + author`
(truncated with an ellipsis), and rows are tinted

by commit SHA so the same
commit shares one colour. Hovering that column shows the blame bubble; ho

vering
the code lines themselves shows nothing.

A shortcut command **"显示/关闭 Git Blame 气泡"** is registered but left unbound;
assign it a key in Setti

ngs → Shortcuts, and the current keycaps appear in the
toggle's tooltip.
## Notes

- The preview is read-only, so the interaction uses the mouse pointer rather
than a text caret.
- Ho

vering the blame gutter column shows the bubble immediately; leaving the
column hides it immediately

.
- The bubble follows just below the cursor. When there is not enough room near
the bottom edge it

flips above the cursor while keeping the same gap.
- The card is slightly translucent (opacity 0.85)

. After ~9 s without pointer
movement it fades over 1 s to opacity 0.15 so it stops hiding the code

us a normal body; the
body is capped at 5 lines and ends with an ellipsis when truncated. When a
com

mit has only a single-line message, that line wraps and uses the full
5-line budget instead of being

clamped to one line.
- Blame is shared per file+commit: consecutive rows belonging to the same comm

it
reuse a single cache entry, so moving the pointer across them is instant and
triggers no reload.

Uncommitted rows keep per-line caching.
- Files outside a Git repository, or lines that are not trac

ked, show a short
explanatory message instead of a commit.
